problem: Reduce false accusations on real English news; preserve honest uncertainty.

metadata.selection_rule: Frozen base estimators; format-specific calibration and regularized fusion selected on tuning. Thresholds selected on policy with a false-accusation cost; no external selection.

release.reason: English statistical screening; factual verification and public deployment are not established.

limitations: Scores identify corpus patterns, not independently verified truth.
Historical datasets do not establish reliability on current or personally written news.
Weak publisher and health-quality labels were excluded from training.
